drakgogo.text: Drakgogo arrived recently and already fights like they have been here for years: upper tier on almost every count, quick hands, and steady when the opposition gets serious. That edge holds up when the opposition gets toughest too, which is rare this early. Young account, early read, but the opening chapters are hard to argue with.

dipstickremovalservice.text: DipstickRemovalService played a fast, confident game: upper tier across nearly the whole card, fast hands, steady when the opposition got serious. When the opposition got toughest, the edge thinned a little, the single soft spot in an otherwise strong card. Quiet for months now, so read this as a record of how they played.

dazzledsquire.text: DazzledSquire is a veteran who still fights near the very top: matchup rating near the top, activity among the very best, and a matchup K/D line that backs it up. The accuracy sits near the top, and the headshot share is right there with it, though the hardest third shaves the edge a little. A veteran who still sets the pace.

dgd6666.text: DGD6666 wins by choosing the moment: among the very best tracked in the matchups, picking fights and then winning them, with headshots doing much of the talking. The aim wanders, and the lifetime board undersells the matchup game. The output does not hunt stronger opposition. The toughest-third hold eases a touch.

dream8nc.text: dream8NC plays like the ceiling of the whole board: among the very best tracked on every count that matters, with a blistering tempo and the sharpest aim on the board. The numbers hold up as the opposition improves, and the lifetime figures line up with the matchups. A complete game, with no soft spot to point at.

daber222.text: Daber222 is a young account and a steady hand: the sharpest aim in the ledger, a kept share that holds high against the strongest third, and a matchup kill-death line among the elite. The trigger holds a good clip, and the headshots are middling. Early read, but the start is loud.

daemon17.text: Daemon17 plays the long, patient game: among the very best tracked, with matchup kill-death numbers up near the very top and a resistance mark that barely moves against the strongest opposition. The pace is slow and the headshots are rare, yet the lifetime IvI sits near the bottom, so the matchups rate them far above the lifetime board. Proof that patience pays.

dvaretskui.text: DVARetskui arrived days ago and already sits top shelf among the matchups, with the kill-death line at the very best and precision to match. That edge holds firm against the hardest third too, rare this early, even for a card this strong. Early read, but the start is impossible to ignore.

dusty.text: Dusty plays a busy, accurate game: high on the matchup board, with the kill-death numbers up near the top. The aim sits mid-table, though the headshots land often, while the lifetime IvI figure trails a little behind. When the heat rises highest, the grip gives way a little.

doktorpsyschonc.text: DoktorPsyschoNC has refined the craft since 2014: the rating rides high, the tempo stays fierce, the nerve holds, the resistance holds with it. The matchup kill-death mark marches in step. The pace stays fierce, the aim stays sharp, and headshots sit above average. The lifetime board concurs, rating the career in the upper ranks, with consistency resting mid-pack.

duwursttr.text: DuWurstTR lands the telling blows: accuracy near the top, headshots among the very best tracked, and a matchup rating to match. Activity, bravery, and resistance all sit near the top, and the lifetime IvI lands near the summit too. Consistency fades below average — the lone blemish on a card that otherwise shines everywhere.

dadagegege.text: DADAgegege is a young account with a loud opening: the matchup rating, activity, and the resistance all press near the top; the matchup kill-death figure stands tall. The aim is sharp, but headshots stay rare, while the lifetime board ranks them near the bottom. Bravery sits mid-pack and the edge drops against the hardest third, so this is an early read on a precise, body-shot game.

dudisfludistr.text: DudisfludisTR has carried a top-shelf game since 2015: the rating, the activity, the bravery, and the resistance all sit near the very top, with the sparring kill-death figure keeping pace. The edge dips a touch against the toughest third, but across a decade the card barely has a soft spot. The pace is strong, the aim is sharp, and headshots land at a solid rate.

duwurtsnc3.text: DuWurtsNC3 has been sharpening this game since 2016, and it shows: the matchup kill-death mark sets the pace too, with rating, tempo, bravery, and resistance all sitting in the upper tier. Accuracy and headshot share both run top-shelf, and the lifetime numbers sit right at the top too. Consistency is the lone middling line on a card built to last.

darkwulfgar.text: DarkWulfgar plays at full throttle, with kill pace near the very top, plus a game that grows sharper as the opposition hardens. The headshot share sits near the top too, and the lifetime board credits them higher still. Accuracy runs a shade below the rest of the card, the lone line that does not quite keep up.

dxilxn.text: DxIlxn plays a complete, high-tempo game: rating, activity, bravery, and resistance all sit near the very top of everyone tracked. A brisk kill pace and sharp accuracy back up a matchup kill-death mark that lands there too. The lifetime board rates them a notch lower than the matchups do, but the card reads strong in every corner.

darelect.text: Darelect is pure pace: activity and bravery both among the very best tracked, with kills coming faster than almost anyone. The matchup rating sits near the top, resistance holds near the top too, and the lifetime board backs up the matchups. Accuracy is sharp, headshots above average, and the output never seems to cool.

diehuman.text: DieHuman plays at full throttle: a furious work rate that holds up as the opposition strengthens, elite resistance, and a matchup kill-death tally to match. The aim is elite, the pace relentless, and the lifetime numbers sit right alongside the matchups — a rare clean sweep across every line. Even against the strongest third, the game holds its shape.

directivehorntr.text: DirectiveHornTR charges in at full volume: output, nerve, and durability all in the top tier, with a lifetime kill-death tally among the best tracked. The consistency mark sags below average, the one blemish on a loud card. Read this one as a sketch — the opponent sample behind it is older and smaller, so the portrait is a draft, not the finished piece.

drzoidbergnc.text: DrZoidbergNC works the angles: bravery and resistance up near the top, rating and activity close behind, and the grudge-match kill-death line holds its ground. Headshots land at a fierce rate, the aim is strong, and the lifetime board holds at the top beside the matchups. Consistency sits mid-pack against the strongest third, a lone wrinkle keeping this veteran card from running clean.

deliciousviciousfamous.text: DeliciousViciousFamous is a whirlwind: every headline mark — rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — all cluster near the summit, with the mano-a-mano kill-death tally holding the same ground. Accuracy and headshots both land near the top, while the lifetime IvI edges a touch above the matchups. Consistency is the soft spot, sitting below average — the fireworks sometimes gutter between outbursts.

daka0029.text: daka0029 has played since 2016 and still sets the pace: activity, bravery, and resistance all near the top, with a matchup kill-death mark near the top too. The headshot share sits just shy of the summit, and the lifetime IvI near the top as well. A veteran card with every line reading strong.

duper1spandex.text: DuPeR1SpAnDeX wins the fights that matter: resistance and matchup kill-death both near the top, with activity and bravery well above average. The pace is middling and the headshot share sits below average, yet the results stay elite, which says the shot selection does the real work. The lifetime board rates them only mid-pack, so the matchups place them well clear of the lifetime numbers.

darkridervs.text: DarkRiderVS plays a measured, high-volume game: rating, activity, bravery all near the very top, resistance there too. The lifetime board still keeps them near the top, and the matchup kill-death sits above average too. Consistency fades below average, the lone wrinkle on a strong card.

duwurstvs.text: DuWurstVS has been a fixture since 2014, and the card reads like a veteran who never lost a step: rating, activity, bravery, and resistance all ride near the top, with a matchup kill-death mark right there with them. The pace is relentless, the aim lands well above average, and headshots make up a striking share. Only the consistency mark sags a little, the one wrinkle in an otherwise complete game.

doyougottaspareciggy.text: DoYouGottaSpareCiggy plays a razor game: a matchup kill-death mark near the very top, with resistance to match. The aim is precise, headshots land with a top-tier share, and the lifetime board tells the same story. Bravery sits a notch below the rest, the one line that keeps this card from perfection.

daoba11.text: daoba11 plays with the throttle pinned: top-tier in the matchups, sustained in tempo, and bravery holding firm as the field hardens. The bout kill-death tally lands well above average. Career numbers read above the pack. Headshots land above the pack, rounding out a card with no weak patch — a player who keeps the pressure on from the first exchange.

donutsnc.text: donutsNC has been at this since 2015, and the years show in the composure: top-tier in the matchups, smooth in tempo, bravery holding as the opposition hardens. The one-on-one kill-death tally sits well above average. The aim runs above the pack, and the lifetime board mirrors the duels closely, which keeps the story clean. A veteran who still wins the fights that matter.

datouyu89.text: DaTouYu89 is the quiet contradiction: a top-shelf rating grounded in resistance that barely bends and a duel record near the very best, while the lifetime board reads far more modestly. The tempo is unhurried, the headshots rare — and yet the matchups keep saying the same thing. A fighter whose strength hides in plain sight.

deeweens.text: DeeWeeNS is a storm front in human form: a top-shelf rating, courage that grows as the opposition toughens, and headshots among the very best tracked. The lifetime numbers paint the same picture as the matchups — this is a fighter at the peak of their craft. A relentless, high-tempo regular.

donzoidx.text: Donzoidx has been fighting since 2013, and the mileage shows in the balance: a top-shelf rating, a shield that barely bends against stronger opposition, and a faceoff tally that holds its line in harder fights. The lifetime ledger sits a notch below the matchups, and the edge holds against the hardest third. A veteran of rare consistency.

djcoldhat.text: Since 2013, djcoldhat has played the same fearless game: upper tier in the matchups, a tempo near the very top, with accuracy to match. Headshots are scarce here — the shots land, just rarely in the head. The lifetime board reads well below the matchups, and the toughest third takes something off the edge — a veteran who never stopped charging.

dorfschamanevondertrinkhalle.text: DorfSchamaneVonDerTrinkhalle plays like a storm front: upper tier on the matchup ledger, a whirlwind tempo, and bravery that keeps pace as enemies get stronger. Headshots land at a rate among the very best tracked — the lifetime numbers agree. The toughest third dulls the edge somewhat — a veteran whose storms still break hard.

dirdra.text: Since 2012, Dirdra has fought at the sharp end: a top-tier matchup rating, activity near the top, and resistance that holds firm. The matchup kill-death tally sits near the top while the lifetime kill-death line sits there too, yet the lifetime IvI line trails middling. The edge thins when the going gets hardest, the one blemish on a long, strong record.

drilleurerkilleurer.text: drilleurerkilleurer brings relentless pressure: a top-tier rating, a rapid tempo, and accuracy among the very best tracked. The direct-fight kill-death record sits top-bracket too, and the lifetime numbers line up behind the matchups. When the strongest third shows up, the edge collapses — the one crack in an otherwise ruthless, polished record.

dumbn00bnc.text: DumbN00bNC plays with a calm, deliberate edge: top-bracket matchup rating, bravery that holds as fights get meaner, and resistance that absorbs stronger fire without bending. Headshots land at a well-above-average clip, and the lifetime IvI lands in the top bracket too. A composed, dangerous regular with a game to match.

dade200.text: dade200 is fresh on the board and already turning heads: a matchup rating up in the top bracket, bravery and resistance both near the top, and headshots at a rate among the very best tracked. The accuracy is still below average, the one rough edge in a loud opening. Early read, but the first pages are impossible to ignore.

dadeathdealer.text: DaDeathDealer is the matchup board's paradox: a matchup rating among the best, resistance that shrugs off stronger opposition, with an edge that holds against the toughest third. Headshots are rare and the lifetime board sits below average, which makes the matchup numbers the whole story. A patient regular whose results live entirely in the fights that count.

darnsoldier.text: Since 2015, DarnSoldier has traded headshots for reliability: a matchup rating among the upper tier, resistance that refuses to yield to stronger opposition, and a faceoff kill-death count near the top. Headshots are scarce and the toughest third takes a bite out of the edge, but the lifetime board stays respectable. A veteran who wins with volume and nerve, not flash.

dpmoo.text: DPMoo is the matchup board's quiet overachiever: a matchup rating sitting up top, resistance that holds firm against stronger opposition, and a lifetime kill-death line near the top. The tempo runs mid-pack, the aim numbers are unremarkable, the lifetime board middling. A regular whose matchup results keep outrunning the rest of the card.
